character: Olympic pedigree, X Games venue, legendary off-piste, 60+ restaurants, locally-spirited village, genuine mountain character at 1,850 m. 6m+ average seasonal snowfall.
description: Val d'Isère is one of the world's great ski resorts — a genuine mountain village with Olympic heritage and world-class off-piste. Linked with Tignes to form Espace Killy (300 km). The terrain splits across 3 sectors: Le Fornet (quiet, snow-sure glacier sector), Solaise (wide blues/reds, sun-trap), and Bellevarde (Olympic Face black run, X Games venue). Host of the 1992 Albertville Olympics, 2009 World Alpine Ski Championships, and annual X Games. 60+ restaurants. Average seasonal snowfall exceeds 6m due to a unique micro-climate. The village has genuine Savoyard character with a historic quarter around the 14th-century church.
sources: Snow Magazine — Roger Fulton, updated 25 Nov 2025

stats.glacier: Glacier de Pissaillas (3,200 m) — summer skiing

weather_snow.microclimate: Unique local micro-climate delivers 6m+ most winters

villages.name: Val d'Isère Centre
villages.character: Genuine mountain village, historic quarter (14th-century church), cobbled streets, 60+ restaurants, lively apres, luxury boutiques and sports shops intermixed. A real year-round community.

villages.name: Le Fornet
villages.character: Quiet glacier-access hamlet at the head of the valley. Snow-sure, peaceful, few amenities. Base of the Pissaillas glacier cable car.

villages.name: La Daille
villages.character: Compact purpose-built satellite, budget-friendly, direct Bellevarde access. Base of the Folie Douce.

apres_bars_specific: **Petit Danois** — best live apres music. Famous 'Red Eric' cocktail. Restaurant section too.
**Cocorico** — apres bar & club, live music on huge outdoor terrace right on piste. Huge apres and late-night venue.
**IMA (formerly Dicks Tea Bar)** — most famous club in the Alps. Large dance floor, two bars, champagne. Open from 11pm.
**Le Hibou** — local's bar, live music, tapas.
**Blue Note** — chilled bar popular with seasonaires, jazz and funk, apres specials 3-6pm.
**Les Fils à Maman (formerly Bananas)** — popular chalet staff hangout, terrace, DJ nights.
**Bar Alexandra** — best snooker and pool venue, top sound system.
**La Folie Douce** — slope-side terrace bar at La Daille, iconic afternoon apres, cabaret show and DJs.
spas: Aquasportif centre — pool with lane swimming, rapids, bubble area, water sprays, aqua aerobics, squash, table tennis, badminton, toddler soft-play café
non_ski_activities.ice_karting: Ice karting circuit at La Daille — go-karting on ice, piste-basher driving experiences, family racing
non_ski_activities.other_activities: Dog sledding, paragliding (tandem), snowshoe walking with helicopter return, speed riding (skiing with kite), helicopter rides over Espace Killy or Mont Blanc, ice climbing at La Daille, ice diving in Tignes le Lac, snowmobiling, winter walking trails
non_ski_activities.events: X Games (January) — world's top freestyle event. Annual Wait and Ski week. Classical recitals in the church.

signature: Gigi's (Tête de Solaise, expensive, wonderful views)
Le Refuge bar (Tête de Solaise, cheese/meat boards, desserts, fire)
L'Etincelle (village level, sunny terrace, DJ, wine selection)
apres_restaurants: Le Peau de Vache / formerly La Tanière (Bellevarde)
La Rosée Blanche, La Daille (terrace lunches)

honest_drawbacks: Expensive — one of the priciest in the Alps
Can be crowded with powder hunters after a dump
High winds close Solaise and Bellevarde summits (50+ days per season)
La Daille has little character compared to Val centre
